scope: Six development cases; separate from the nine-case Gemini plan and four lifecycle cases

subject.text: Our macOS app uses AVPlayerItem. Add helpers for explicit language selection, optionally requiring audio description, and for turning a group off when allowed. A subtitle language choice should pick a full subtitle option, not a forced-only variant. If a requested choice is missing, leave the existing choice alone. Changing subtitles must preserve the audio selection. Groups come from the current item asset. Target macOS26; keep system automatic selection policy alone until the user explicitly chooses. Show unit tests without playback or UI automation.

subject.text: For a macOS player inspector, extract audio/subtitle option names, languages, audio-description and forced-only flags, and which options are selected. Load asset metadata asynchronously. Distinguish no current item, a successfully loaded but absent group, and a load error. Inspecting must not change the chosen audio or subtitle-off state. Show a testable implementation targeting macOS26 and explain what a tagged silent local test asset can establish.

subject.text: We are adding a diagnostic snapshot to our macOS AVPlayer app. Capture duration, loaded and seekable ranges, buffer flags, rate, time-control status and waiting reason without modifying playback. Missing item data must stay distinguishable from empty data. We also need a helper telling whether a time is inside the captured seekable ranges. How would you implement and unit-test this for macOS26 without a network stream?
